title: A Compass for the Current
author: Felix Almeida
blurb: Jonah Hartwell, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, has spent twelve years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
